label: Plugin Manager
description: Runtime load/unload/reload of other plugins without restarting the server.

commands.name: load
commands.description: Loads the specified plug-in (omitting the file extension).

commands.name: loadall
commands.description: Loads all plug-ins specified in the qlx_plugins cvar.

commands.name: unloadall
commands.description: Unloads all currently loaded plug-ins (except plugin_manager itself).

commands.name: reloadall
commands.description: Reloads all currently loaded plug-ins (except plugin_manager itself).
